high_level_description: This image depicts a breathtaking aerial view of the sky at either sunrise or sunset, characterized by a warm, orange hue that dominates the scene. The horizon is filled with dense, fluffy clouds that stretch across the lower portion of the image, creating a textured and layered effect. Above the clouds, the sky transitions into a darker shade, dotted with numerous stars, suggesting it is either early morning or late evening. At the center of the image, there is a bright, star-like object emitting a radiant glow.
